items.originalTitle: Jacques Villeneuve defends Red Bull team orders call at F1 Azerbaijan GP
items.summaryEn: 1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve has backed Red Bull's decision not to swap Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: 雅克·维伦纽夫为红牛在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上的车队指令决定进行辩护
雅克·维伦纽夫支持红牛在阿塞拜疆大奖赛期间不交换马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔位置的决定
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
1997年F1世界冠军雅克·维伦纽夫支持红牛在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上的策略。
在充满挑战的巴库城市赛道上，比赛进入尾声阶段时，马克斯·维斯塔潘与队友伊萨克·哈贾尔前后紧随行驶。
尽管哈贾尔拥有轮胎优势，但这支位于米尔顿凯恩斯的车队并没有指示这位四届世界冠军让出赛道位置，以便让这位法国裔阿尔及利亚车手向前方赛车发起进攻。
维斯塔潘在最后几圈成功拉开差距，向比赛冠军乔治·拉塞尔发起挑战。维斯塔潘最终以第二名完赛，仅落后这位梅赛德斯车手0.196秒。哈贾尔此前因手腕伤病缺席了六周，最终获得第三名。
在接受天空体育一级方程式节目采访时，维伦纽夫驳斥了红牛应该交换车手位置的说法，并称赞了这支由洛朗·梅基斯领导的车队对比赛的解读。
“那非常完美，”这位加拿大车手说。“没有任何理由让马克斯给伊萨克让车。
哈贾尔当时用的是更好的轮胎，而且圈速和马克斯很接近。所以在某个时间点他们本来会交换轮胎，而正如我们所看到的，马克斯在最后几圈把差距拉大到了对哈贾尔的八秒。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队；伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
“马克斯冲到最前面的机会更大，所以他们做的是正确的。”
梅基斯确认，车队确实考虑过车队指令方面的各种选择。
“说实话，我们研究了所有这些情况，然后我们选择让赛车保持在当时的位置上，”这位车队负责人告诉天空体育F1。
“两位车手在保持纪律方面都做得非常好。也要大大地夸一夸伊萨克，他跑得非常聪明，确保我们拿到了最好的团队成绩。”
“我们觉得这是争取超过皮亚斯特里和拉塞尔的最好机会。在这里，很难不去指望某一时刻会出现安全车。我们都在等待安全车。”
"马克斯在那个阶段用中性胎很挣扎，而我们知道用软胎会有更好的机会。最终，事情正是这样发展的。"
"我们差了0.1秒，但我们获得了与他战斗的机会，并且展现出了与他相同的节奏。"
detailEn: Jacques Villeneuve defends Red Bull team orders call at F1 Azerbaijan GP
Jacques Villeneuve has backed Red Bull's decision not to swap Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve has backed Red Bull's Azerbaijan Grand Prix strategy.
During the closing stages of the race on the demanding Baku City Circuit, Max Verstappen and team-mate Isack Hadjar were running one behind the other.
Although Hadjar had a tyre advantage, the Milton Keynes outfit chose not to instruct the four-time champion to yield track position to allow the French-Algerian driver to attack the cars ahead.

Verstappen managed to pull away in the final laps to mount a challenge to race winner George Russell. Verstappen ultimately finished second, just 0.196 seconds behind the Mercedes driver. Hadjar, who had been out with a wrist injury for six weeks, finished third.
Speaking on the Sky Sports F1 broadcast, Villeneuve dismissed suggestions that Red Bull should have swapped its drivers, praising the Laurent Mekies-led team's reading of the race.
"It was perfect," the Canadian said. "There was no reason to ask Max to let Isack by.
"Hadjar was on the better tyre and the lap time was similar to Max. So at one point they would swap over the tyre and, as we've seen, Max built an eight-second gap on Hadjar [in the final laps].
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
"Max had a better chance of getting to the front so they did the right thing."
Mekies confirmed the team did consider its options regarding team orders.
"We looked at all these scenarios, honestly, and then we elected to hold the car in those positions," the team chief told Sky Sports F1.
"Both drivers have been very good at being disciplined with that. Big well done also to Isack who has raced very cleverly to make sure we get the best team result.
"We felt it was the best chance to get a chance at Piastri and at Russell. It's very difficult here not to count on a safety car at some stage. We were all waiting for the safety car.
"Max was struggling with the medium at that stage and we knew that on the soft we would have a better chance. Ultimately, that's what happened.
"We are missing one tenth but we got a chance to fight with him and show we had the same pace."
keyPointsZh: 比赛尾声在巴库城市赛道，维斯塔潘与队友伊萨克·哈德前后行驶，哈德虽拥有轮胎优势，红牛仍选择不互换位置
keyPointsEn: During the closing stages on the Baku City Circuit, Verstappen and Isack Hadjar ran one behind the other, and despite Hadjar's tyre advantage, Red Bull chose not to instruct the four-time champion to yield track position.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔巴库杆位到冠军：「感觉又找回了自己」，余下赛季目标「每场都赢」
items.summaryZh: 拉塞尔在巴库包揽周四练习最快、杆位和正赛冠军，把与队友安东内利的积分差距从81分缩小到66分。这是他自6月奥地利站以来的首个分站冠军、本季第3胜，而安东内利目前已赢8场。谈到信心回归，他说是对新采用的驾驶风格积累了更多经验：「夏休之后每一站我都觉得越来越强，感觉又更像自己了。」（来源：Formula 1）
items.originalTitle: George Russell ‘feels like myself again’ after ‘incredible’ pole-to-victory drive in Azerbaijan
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔周六在巴库城市赛道顶住了马克斯·维斯塔潘的猛烈追击，拿下个人2026赛季第三场胜利。
乔治·拉塞尔盛赞自己在阿塞拜疆度过了一个从头到尾都「不可思议」的周末：这位梅赛德斯车手在周四练习中排名第一，以统治级表现夺得杆位，最终拿下胜利，并借此把队友基米·安东内利在车手积分榜上的领先优势削减了15分。
拉塞尔来到本站时落后安东内利81分，他在冲向方格旗的较量中力压红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘，把差距缩小到66分；而这位年轻的意大利车手在第一节排位发生戏剧性事故后，正赛从第16位追到了第五。
这是拉塞尔自6月奥地利站以来的首个分站冠军，也是他2026赛季迄今的第三胜，而安东内利目前已经赢了8场。
「重回领奖台最高处的感觉太棒了，」拉塞尔赛后说，「我只想特别感谢我的车队，他们在艰难时刻一直相信我，帮我挺了过来。我为这个周末感到非常自豪。
「比赛前半段感觉相当顺利，一直在拉开差距，然后是安全车重启……当我看到马克斯在身后，我就想『这不会轻松』。他在比赛最后阶段开得非常出色。
「黄旗出来的时候（因为瓦尔特利·博塔斯撞车），我收了油，等我再踩下去时没有涡轮，所以也就没有动力。马克斯差点在终点线上超过我，那样就太可惜了。总的来说，这是一个不可思议的周末。」
被问到信心似乎已经回来时，拉塞尔补充说：「我想只是对我采用的这种新驾驶风格有了更多经验。夏休之后的每一场比赛，我都觉得自己越来越强。我感觉又更像我自己了，这真的很棒。」
至于在剩余分站中如何追赶安东内利，这位英国车手明确表达了自己的意图。
「每场都赢！这就是计划。」他笑着说，「我的队友这个赛季表现不可思议，几乎一直无懈可击，但现在到了关键时刻。
「我只会专注于自己。如果我能继续像这个周末一样发挥，无论赛季末发生什么，我都会很开心。这段时间对我来说非常艰难，现在我感觉自己已经走出来了。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: George Russell fended off a charging Max Verstappen to claim his third victory of the 2026 season at the Baku City Circuit on Saturday.

George Russell hailed an “incredible” weekend from start to finish in Azerbaijan, with the Mercedes driver topping Thursday practice, charging to a dominant pole and ultimately securing victory – cutting team mate Kimi Antonelli’s championship lead by 15 points in the process.

Russell headed into the event 81 points behind Antonelli, but trimmed that gap to 66 by edging out Red Bull’s Max Verstappen in a dash to the chequered flag, while the young Italian recovered from 16th to fifth after a dramatic Q1 accident.
It marks Russell’s first Grand Prix victory since Austria in June, and his third of the 2026 season so far, comparing to the eight Antonelli has achieved up to this point.

“It’s amazing to be back on the top step of the podium,” Russell commented post-race. “I just want to say a big thanks to my team, because they continued to believe in me through tough moments, helped me come through it. I’m really proud to have had this weekend.

“The first half of the race felt pretty plain sailing, getting the gap, the Safety Car restart… When I saw Max behind, I thought, ‘It’s not going to be easy’. He drove incredibly at the end of the race.

“When the yellow flag came out [for Valtteri Bottas’ crash], I lifted off the power, and when I went back, I had no turbo, so then I had no power. Max almost got me at the line, so that would have been a real shame. All in all, an incredible weekend.”

Asked about his confidence seemingly returning, Russell added: “I think it’s just having more experience with this sort of new driving style that I’ve adopted. Every race since the [summer] break I feel like I’ve gone from strength to strength. I feel like more myself again, so that’s really great.”
As for how he plans to approach the remaining rounds of the championship, in his quest to overhaul Antonelli, the Briton made his intentions clear.
“Win every race! That’s the game plan,” he stated with a smile. “My team mate’s had an incredible season, he’s been pretty flawless throughout, but now we’re getting to crunch time.

“I’m just going to focus on myself. If I continue delivering performances like I’ve done this weekend, no matter what happens towards the end of the season, I’ll be happy. It’s been a really tough period for me, and now I feel like I’ve come through the other side.”
